content: aBayaahudi basidaka Paawulo emw'omurhegesi Feliiki

Enyuma w'esiku erhaano, omudaahwa mukulu oyirikwa Hananiya aja eKayizariya haguma n'abashamuka baguma b'aBayaahudi n'omuntu w'okubabuuranira oyirikwa Teritulo. Nabo bahika embere z'omurhegesi Feliiki, basidaka Paawulo.

Babeere bahamagala Paawulo, Teritulo arhondera kumusidaka n'okuderha ntya: «Mukengwa Feliiki, werhumire rhwabwona omurhuula munene n'oburhegesi bwawe bukwiriire bwarhumire ebintu binene byaba binja mw'echi gihugo.
Kooko waliha Feliiki, rhurhakayibirira ebi byooshi ngasi hooshi na ngasi gihe.
Aliko, ogurhaguhezeza ebishanji, nguhemere oyunviirize omu bwinja bwawe ebinwa rhwashonda kuderha oku bugeeke.
Rhwabwene oku oyu muntu ali mudaarhi bweneene. Y'ararusa aBayaahudi booshi omu gulu lyooshi. Kandi, yeewe ye mukulu w'edini ly'obubeeshi ly'aBanazareeti.
Abaaga ashondere guhumaanya eNju ya Nnamahanga, aliko rhwamamufarha. [Rhwashondaga kumuhana gukulikarana n'eRhegeko lyeerhu,
aliko Lusiya, mukulu w'engabo y'abasoda, amayinja gurhunyugushula ye.
Anabwira abo basidaakire Paawulo oku bayinje eno mwawe.]
Wooyo wenyine wakamubuuranya y'omenya bwinjabwinja ebi byooshi rhumusidakiire.»
aBayaahudi baliiri aho, bahamiriza okw'eyo myaazi yooshi ya Teritulo eri y'okuli.
Paawulo abuurana embere za Feliiki

Oku buzinda, omurhegesi Feliiki asimira Paawulo mpu naye aderhe. Paawulo aderha ntya: «Waliha Feliiki, nyinji oku gurhengera myaaka minene oli muzuuzi w'olu lubaga. Boboola, nta buuba ngwerhe b'okubuuranira embere zaawe.
Wenyine wakanabaza, banakubwira oku harhazigera siku ekumi n'ebiri njire eYerusaleema guharamya Nnamahanga.

Aba bantu bansidaakire, nta muguma wabo wanshimaanire omu Nju ya Nnamahanga changwa omu masinagoogi maabo, changwa ahandi ahantu omu gishagala ndi najira obuhaka n'omuntu changwa ndi nararusa olubaga.
Kandi, barhakagala gukuyeereka bwinjabwinja elugulu w'ebi bansidaakire ko bunoola.

Aliko nyemereere embere zaawe oku ndi nakolera Nnamahanga wa bashookuluza beerhu omu gukulikira eNjira ya Nnaweerhu. Yi banaderha okw'eri y'obubeeshi. Si nyoono, nyemereere byooshi biyandikirwe omu bitaabu by'eRhegeko n'omu by'abaleebi.
Ngwerhe obulangaalire kuguma nabo emwa Nnamahanga oku nj'afuula abantu booshi, abakwaneene n'ababi.
Cho girhumire ndi nagihangaana esiku zooshi kuba n'oboorhere bwinja embere za Nnamahanga n'embere z'abantu.
«Nabeere najira myaaka minene ntali eYerusaleema, nagaluka yo. Naliiri naaja guhekera abakene bali omu lubaga lwani oburhabaale n'ogurhuulira Nnamahanga entuulo.
Egihe naliiri narhula entuulo eyi nagicheeseze, aba bantu banshimaana omu Nju ya Nnamahanga. Nta rarusaga abantu na nta chigusho ch'abantu naliiri nacho.
Aliko, Bayaahudi baguma barhengeraga omu gihugo ch'eAziya baliiri aho. Abo babakayinjire embere zaawe kunsidaaka, akaba bagwerhe echinwa elugulu waani.
Changwa, aba bantu baderhe chibi gichi bambwene ko amango bansidaakaga embere z'akabuga k'aBayaahudi.
Nkabaga echibi chiguma najirire, nayaamaga embere zaabo ntya: ‹Mumpanire ntya zeene kwenge ngwerhe obulangaalire okw'abafu nji bafuuka.›»
Feliiki waliyinji bwinjabwinja ebiyerekeere eNjira ya Nnaweerhu, abwira abalisidakire Paawulo ntya: «Olu lushinja lwenyu nji nalucha amango Lusiya, omukulu w'engabo y'abasoda nj'ahika hano.»
Oku buzinda, arhegeka omukulu w'abasoda ahire Paawulo omu munyororo, aliko amulekere ebishanji by'okujira ebyashondere, analeke abeera baage baleme bamurhabaala.
Paawulo ashambaala na Feliiki haguma na Durusila
Enyuma wa siku zigeeke, Feliiki ahika haguma na mukaage Durusila, waliiri Muyaahudi-kazi. Arhegeka balerhe Paawulo, naye ayunviriza ebinwa aliiri aderha elugulu w'obwemeezi omu Yeesu Krisitu.

Aliko Feliiki abeere ayunva Paawulo ashambaala elugulu wa byooshi bikwaneene embere za Nnamahanga, elugulu w'oguchilanga n'amabi, n'elugulu w'olusiku Nnamahanga nj'achiira abantu olushinja, ayuubaha. Abwira Paawulo ntya: «Bunoola okola wakagenda. Nji nashuba kuguhamagala amango nabona ebishanji.»
Aliiri alangalire oku Paawulo amuha efuranga. Elugulu w'echo, alema ahamagala Paawulo ngasi mango oku baganiire haguma.
Habeere hagera myaaka ebiri, Porikiyo Fesito ayima ahali ha Feliiki. Aliko Feliiki aleka Paawulo omu munyororo kwenge alishondere gusimiisa aBayaahudi.
